extendedHorizonProbe.interpretation: A single deterministic heuristic continuation reached a rules terminal when the research-only horizon was extended. This is a runtime smoke only, not a candidate comparison or strategy result.

priorRuntimeComparison.runtime: tsx/ESM planner with CJS search worker
priorRuntimeComparison.interpretation: The mixed-module runtime generated plans that diverged during CJS replay. Those execution failures are not attributed to strategy quality and the v4 executable-plan metrics must not be reused as validated planner behavior.

interpretation: The CJS planner bundle and CJS engine worker executed every candidate plan for this one-position smoke. At the prior 80-decision horizon all rollouts truncated. One follow-up 300-decision research-only probe reached a terminal, but it produced no candidate comparison or training target. This verifies execution parity for one position only; it does not establish broad planner correctness or playing strength.
changes: The research planner is now bundled as CJS by npm run engine:build.
The collector requires and hashes the CJS planner bundle, worker source, and planner source before collection.
The frozen v2 observation and earlier artifacts were not modified.
Macro collection now freezes a per-rollout wall-clock budget and labels budget cutoffs separately from horizon cutoffs; both remain truncated and unscored.

boundedCollectorSmoke.interpretation: The bounded collector completed all candidate calls, classified every timed continuation as a budget truncation, and produced no outcome labels. This is runtime and accounting evidence only; the one-second cap is too short to measure strength.

rolloutProgressDiagnostic.interpretation: A five-second cap reached terminal states for 30 of 42 candidate continuations. The remaining 12 were budget-truncated. One sample per candidate is not a reliable ranker target; these results estimate runtime only and do not establish strategic quality.

twoWorkerThroughputDiagnostic.interpretation: Two workers reduced wall time in this single diagnostic while producing the same per-candidate terminal/truncated status and completed scores as serial execution. Decision counts differed for some budget-limited samples, as expected when wall-clock cutoff timing changes. These are preliminary throughput measurements, not a scaling guarantee or strategy evidence.
